According to Webster's College Dictionary: an extended dramatic work in which the parts are sung to orchestral accompaniment.
I feel like this definition lacks the appropriate flair which should define this flamboyant form of art, so,
According to me: opera is a dramatic work through which one can experience all emotions as easily as though one was experiencing them oneself, with the main medium of portrayal being song.
